summary.name: GPTExcel
summary.one_liner: GPTExcel is an AI assistant for Excel and CSV files that answers plain-English requests by producing formulas, pivot tables, charts, slide decks and summaries.
use_cases: Writing Excel formulas from plain-English descriptions
Building pivot tables from uploaded sales data
Analyzing a sales report for revenue and margin drivers
HR headcount and turnover analysis from an employee list
Speeding up a slow Excel workbook
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI spreadsheet assistant where users upload Excel or CSV files and ask questions in plain English. Outputs named include formulas, pivot tables, charts, slide decks and summaries. A guides section gives worked examples in GPTExcel covering sales report analysis, budget vs actual variance, HR analytics, and workbook performance tuning. Other guides compare XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP and INDEX/MATCH, and explain the difference between Excel's FLATTEN and Google Sheets' FLATTEN. The page text does not describe the underlying technology or data handling in detail.
notable: Plain-English questions over uploaded Excel or CSV files
Worked guides with prompts for sales, budget, and HR analysis
Guides comparing XLOOKUP, VLOOKUP and INDEX/MATCH
caveats: The page says it is free to start; paid tier details are not given on the page text
The collective-ai-tools listing marks it as #paid, which conflicts with the 'free to start' wording on the page
